status_evidence: https://www.dominos.is/panta/pizzur and /stadir rendered live 2026-10-23 (prices, 22 stores, ordering site up). Wolt Akureyri page also live.

sources.note: Names rendered in capitals by the site (CSS); converted to normal case here. English site path /en/... returned 404, so desc_en left empty.
22 stores with address, postal code, town, hours, pickup/delivery estimates; no per-store phone shown.

sources.type: Wolt (only used to cross-check prices vs own site)
sources.note: Wolt prices are higher than own site for the same pizza (e.g. Hvítlaukur.is/Garlic.is Wolt 5,690 vs own site large 5,390), so Wolt is not used for item prices.

price_basis: own site list prices (dominos.is/panta/pizzur), regular price, ISK incl. VAT. Banner on the site at fetch time said all pizzas and sides were 50% off for pickup; list prices shown are the regular ones.
sizes_note: Site labels sizes only as Lítil / Mið. / Stór / Pan (no inch sizes shown). price = Mið., price_large = Stór. Pan (pan crust, same price as Stór) in sizes_all.

English item descriptions not available (English site path not found). Inch sizes not shown. Per-store prices not verifiable without the ordering flow (store/address selection); see price note.
price_variation_note: Could not verify whether prices differ by branch: dominos.is shows one price list and store selection happens in the order flow (not used). Wolt (Akureyri) prices are different from the own site (higher), so delivery-platform prices differ from own-site prices.

restaurant.name: Domino's Pizza
restaurant.description_is: Domino's Pizza er pizzakeðja á Íslandi með 22 staði samkvæmt dominos.is/stadir, í Reykjavík, Kópavogi, Garðabæ, Hafnarfirði, Mosfellsbæ, Akureyri, Akranesi, Selfossi og Keflavík; pantað er til að sækja eða fá sent heim.
restaurant.description_en: Domino's Pizza is a pizza chain in Iceland with 22 stores listed on dominos.is/stadir, in Reykjavík, Kópavogur, Garðabær, Hafnarfjörður, Mosfellsbær, Akureyri, Akranes, Selfoss and Keflavík; orders are for pickup or delivery.
restaurant.address_note: Head-office address not found; main entry = first store listed on dominos.is/stadir (Skeifan 17, Reykjavík).
restaurant.opening_hours_note: Skeifan 17 store hours (SUN-FIM 11:00-01:00, FÖS-LAU 11:00-03:00); delivery ends earlier (SUN-FIM 00:00, FÖS-LAU 01:00). Other stores differ, see branches.
